## Why visit

A small frontage conceals one of the most rewarding traditional interiors in the region. Walk through the oak-panelled drinking corridor and look for the separate vault, smoke room, stained glass and service details. Its scale is part of the pleasure: a convincing working pub rather than a grand hall. This is a particularly strong November choice because CAMRA lists Robinsons Old Tom as a winter offering, although the exact day’s availability needs checking. The Swan and Arden Arms together give a compact and unusually rich introduction to Stockport pub heritage.

## Beer

Robinsons cask beers are documented; CAMRA lists Old Tom as winter-only. Ask whether it is on, and consider a small measure. Robinsons Dizzy Blonde is a documented regular; Old Tom is winter-only and remains conditional after the 7 November cask launch.

## Plan the visit

Choose for its CAMRA three-star historic interior and local cask rather than a guaranteed full meal or broad guest range.

**Getting there:** Central Stockport, on Princes Street, walkable from the station.
